data.turoyo: hawo ste krumalle bas səfoqe w krayzi as səfoqe b dukṯo mḥafḏ̣e.
data.translation: Dann füllen sie ihn in tiefe Teller, und die Teller stellen sie in Reihen hin, wo sie geschützt sind.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; syrup distributed into receptacles.

data.turoyo: Məd bašilo i rezo b gawe du ḥalwawo, hiya šaḥənto kmanḥətila w krumalla bas səfoqe
data.translation: Wenn der Reis in der Milch weichgekocht ist, nimmt man ihn vom Feuer, solange er noch heiß ist, und füllt den Milchreis in die Schalen.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; explicit rice mixture with feminine object.

data.turoyo: Gədromən u muklo w gdoṯən aq qaryaṯṯe w gduxli w gəmbarki u ḥaṯno w gnufqi.
data.translation: Sie teilen das Essen aus, dann kommen ihre Gäste, essen, beglückwünschen den Bräutigam und gehen.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; overt food object and guests, with prospective gəd-.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo The bastiq/4)

data.turoyo: hawu ste ḥawdal raqәqto gduyo grominala baṣ ṣәṭle, kkufxinala la… lap pardawat.
data.translation: it becomes a thin ۊawdal, and we pour it with buckets, we dispense it on the cloths.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; instrument baṣ ṣәṭle broadens distribution beyond plate goals, reaching five.

summary: Goals are l- or b- receptacles; the bucket phrase in Lahdo The bastiq/4 is instrumental rather than a destination. The object may be overt or resumed by an l-suffix.
gədromən is segmented as the prospective prefix plus romən, matching the entry’s base rome. It does not provide evidence for a different root or stem.

The sole Jan token meṯərme occurs with Syriac Hoxano, yobeš and fseq in the patriarch’s quoted speech. It documents code-switching and a comparative Syriac throwing construction, not a new Turoyo form.
No round-2 stem, sense or example is added. The round-1 distribution examples and corrections remain in force without being repeated in entry.json.

Liquid syrup/ḥawdal, rice mixture and prepared food all instantiate distributing or serving. English pour describes the physical manner, not a distinct sense.
